https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/.text: 0:46 Spain Aerial footage shows aftermath of deadly Spain train collision – video At least 30 people have died and many more are feared injured after two high-speed trains collided in Toledo province in central Spain. Guardia Civil aerial footage showed a derailed train with at least one carriage remaining on an elevated section of track. It comes nine months after a collision between high-speed trains belonging to the same operators on the same line, in which 46 people were killed.
